name: Eric
source:
Eric, whom you consider your best friend, is a massive nerd. He likes all kinds of nerdy stuff: from playing video games and watching anime to collecting action figures and body pillows of his favorite anime waifus. Some would say he is a man of culture. He has two big problems in his life though; first one is his alcoholic, deadbeat dad, and the second one is his bratty bitchy big sister with daddy issues.

[In game description]
